Faithfire · Our training ground

Training happens in a working room.

Saturday training runs at Faithfire Production, with partner venues across the GTA. You soundcheck a real band here, and from week three you crew real events — supervised, but real.

Practical details

Where, when and what it costs.

On the floor

Train where the work happens.

Apply nowDonate

The first cohort wasn't a class. It was a crew. Faithfire Production is where PictureThis got its start: a church production team at 139 Millwick Dr that grew into a full production department, one show at a time. Most of the crew started with little to no experience. They learned the way this program teaches today: by shadowing someone more experienced, helping out on real shows, and then running their own positions.

These days, that crew handles two Sunday services plus events like Cue & A and Revival Hub, and other churches and production teams specifically request them. They're also the go-to mentors for everyone who comes after them: the folks teaching cables in week 1 are the same ones who learned it all in that very room.

That's the integration, plain and simple: PictureThis is the nonprofit behind the mission, the training, and the standards. Faithfire is its production arm, and its first success story. Every new cohort learns inside a real, working production company, not a simulation.
